RECITALS
1.Lessor is the owner of certain real property, generally described and depicted on
the FINAL PLAT, NORTH CHEYENNE COMMUNITY PARK, ANADDITION TO THE
CITYOF CHEYENNE, which is situated in the North One-Half of Section 21, and the East
One-Half of Section 16, in Township 14 North, Range 66 West, 6" P.M., Laramie County,
Wyoming, and which is comprised of approximately 173.48 acres, more or less, which is
currently being used by the Lessor for public outdoor recreational activities.
2.The parties desire to execute this Lease for the purpose of granting Lessee the
right to use and occupy an areaof land which is One Hundred Feet inlength and One Hundred
Feet in width in the approximate location depicted on Attachment A, appended to this Lease, to
be used by Lessee solely for the purpose of installing and using ambient air quality monitor(s)
and such other equipment as necessary to carry out the governmental function of air quality
monitoring. The area subject to this Lease is hereinafter referred to as“Premises.
3.The parties desire to enter into this Lease for the purpose of defining their rights,
duties and liabilities relating to the Premises. In consideration of the matters described above,
and of the mutual benefits and obligations set forth in this Lease, the parties agree as follows
below.
4. Lessor, by this Lease, grants to Lessee the right to use the Premises for the sole
ofthis Lease.
5.Thetermof this Leases hall commence on the last date that authorized
representatives of Lessor and Lessee have executed this Lease ("Effective Date"), as provided
herein, and shall continue thereafter for a term of ninety-six (96) months, unless sooner
terminated in accordance with the provisions here of.
6.This Lease is not valid and shall not become effective until it is signed by an
authorized representative of the Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality, an authorized

7.The Lessee shall pay rent to Lessor in the amount of Two-Thousand Five
Hundred Dollars ($2,500.00) per year. The first annual rent payment shall be due within sixty
(60) days after the Effective Date of this Lease and within sixty (60) days after each anniversary
of the Effective Date during the term of this Lease.All rent payments shall be delivered to the
City Treasurer at the address stated above in this Lease.The total amount of rent during the
term of this Lease shall not exceed Twenty Thousand Dollars (S20,000.00).
8.Solong as Lessee is not in default with regard to any terms and conditions of the
Lease, the Lessee shall have the right to use the Premises for the purposes described herein and
Lessor shall not conduct any activity on the Premises which would unreasonably interfere with
theuse of the Premises by Lessee.
9.In the event this Lease, or the payment of rent by Lessee pursuant to this Lease,
causes the Premises, or any adjacent property owned by Lessor, tobe subjected to taxation by the
Laramie County Assessor, or other governmental offcial, Lessee shall pay any and all such taxes
and Lessee hereby agrees topaythe same.
10.Lessee shall not use the Premises for any purpose other than those governmental
purposes described herein.Lessor understands that such governmental purposes may include
staff tours of the site, as needed from time to time by Lessee (DEQ)for training purposes.Lessee
shall not store or use any hazardous or flammable materials on the Premises without the prior
express written consent of Lessor.Lessee shall not engage in any activity on the Premises that
would create unreasonable risks of harm, injury or damage to the Premises, to adjacent land
owned by Lessor, or to persons who may be lawfully present on the Premises or adjacent land.
Each party to this Contract shall assume the risk of any liability arising from its own conduct.
Neither party agrees to insure, defend or indemnify the other.
11.Lessee shall not construct any permanent improvements on the Premises without
the express written consent of Lessor. At the conclusion of the term of this Lease, Lessee shall
surrender the Premises to Lessee in the same condition as existed upon the Effective Date of this
Lease, except for ordinary wear and tear arising from Lessee's use of the Premises.
12.During the term of this Lease and for any further time that the Lessee shall hold
the Premises, Lessee shall provide coverage through its commercial insurance program for
personal property kept at the Premises.To the extent allowable under the Governmental Claims
Act, the Lessee shall be self-insured for liability through the State Self Insurance Program
(SSIP).
13.This Lease shall be governed by the laws of the State of Wyoming.Litigation
relating to this Lease shall be filed in the First Judicial District Court, Laramie County,
